description: This script automates the process of tagging, pushing, and managing Docker images for a Playwright project. It handles version retrieval, release channel validation, image tagging for different Ubuntu versions ('jammy' and 'noble'), architecture-specific tagging ('amd64' and 'arm64'), and creates and pushes Docker manifests. It also manages the installation of the 'oras' tool if needed, to attach lifecycle annotations to Docker images.

methods.name: tag_and_push
methods.description: Tags a Docker image with a target tag and pushes it to the registry, then attaches end-of-life manifest.

methods.name: attach_eol_manifest
methods.description: Attaches an end-of-life manifest to a Docker image using the 'oras' tool and current date.

methods.name: install_oras_if_needed
methods.description: Checks if 'oras' is installed; if not, downloads and extracts it.

methods.name: publish_docker_images_with_arch_suffix
methods.description: Builds and pushes Docker images for specific architecture and flavor, tagging them accordingly.

methods.name: publish_docker_manifest
methods.description: Creates and pushes Docker image manifests for multi-architecture images.
